from AlgorithmImports import *


class PrivateLotStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        self.spy_closes.Add(spy_close)
        self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_close)

        if not self.spy_closes.IsReady or not self.aapl_closes.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        current_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(100)) / 100.0
        previous_spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 101)) / 100.0

        spy_crossed_above = (
            self.spy_closes[1] <= previous_spy_sma and
            self.spy_closes[0] > current_spy_sma
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            self.spy_closes[1] >= previous_spy_sma and
            self.spy_closes[0] < current_spy_sma
        )

        aapl_three_red_days = (
            self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
            self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and
            self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
        )

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and aapl_three_red_days:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 // aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

            self.add_equity("AIG", Resolution.DAILY).symbol

        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS)

        self.previous_closes = {}
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def on_data(self, slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if slice.bars.contains_key(symbol):
                bar = slice.bars[symbol]

                if symbol == self.spy:
                    self.spy_sma.update(self.time, bar.close)
                    self.spy_closes.add(bar.close)

                if symbol == self.aapl:
                    self.aapl_rsi.update(self.time, bar.close)

                    if symbol in self.previous_closes:
                        if bar.close < self.previous_closes[symbol]:
                            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                        else:
                            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

                self.previous_closes[symbol] = bar.close

        if any(not slice.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if (not self.spy_sma.is_ready or
                not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready or
                self.spy_closes.count < 101 or
                self.aapl not in self.previous_closes):
            return

        spy_bar = slice.bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = slice.bars[self.aapl]

        current_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value

            previous_spy_close <= previous_sma and
            current_spy_close > current_sma
        )
        crosses_below_sma = (
            previous_spy_close >= previous_sma and
            current_spy_close < current_sma
        )

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and crosses_below_sma:
            self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
            self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and crosses_above_sma:
            shares = int((self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) / current_spy_close)
            if shares > 0:

                shares = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, shares)
